<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>You’d like to power up more <$cdef(27)>streetlights to brighten up the
place, eh?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>If you bring a Pokémon who can <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)> electricity to
a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1703)>, I’m sure <$voicel(1,6)>they could help you!
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>So, you’re hoping to build a habitat with some fire in it?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>In that case, you should probably prepare things like
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1278)> or <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>Once you’ve done that, bring a Pokémon who can
use flames to come and light the fire!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>We need to make this whole town brighter to
awaken <$cdef(27)>Snorlax!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>And I think the best way to accomplish that would be to
place various light sources all around town.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,9)>But putting too many lights in one place would just be a
waste. <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comcan(1)>Be sure to space them out to spread the light!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,2)>When you feel like the town’s gotten a bit brighter, come
check on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>I’d like you to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1622)>. It would help cheer
up <$cdef(27)>Peakychu too.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>It’d be best to put it near <$cdef(27)>Snorlax,<$cdef(27)> if you’re able.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>And don’t forget to bring a Pokémon who can <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(9)>
electricity to help you turn it on.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Try placing some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> to connect the power
from the <$cdef(27)><$bfull(33)>.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Bear in mind that <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)><$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> won’t connect if you
place them too far apart!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Try placing a <$cdef(27)>streetlight next to a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)> that’s
already hooked up to electricity.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>If you manage to turn on the <$cdef(27)>streetlight, you can do the
same thing again and again <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>to brighten up the whole town!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>You can power lots of lights at once using a <$cdef(27)>generator
and <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1396)>.

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>However, you’ll need a good deal of <$cdef(27)><$ifull(107)> and other
materials to make them.

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,4)><$kfacial(1)>Why not get help from the other Pokémon to procure
the materials?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,660)><$facial(1,2)>Could you connect this device to a great deal of
electricity? <$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,4)><$cdef(27)>Peakychu appears to have a plan!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>If you look closely, you’ll see several little lights.

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>I think we can assume this device will be usable once all
those lights are on.
